0022600181.text: The Minnesota Timberwolves (5-3, 2-2 on the road, 8th in the West) visit the Houston Rockets (7-1, 1st in the West and the Southwest) for the Timberwolves' 9th game of the season, with Minnesota coming in on a one-game win streak and Houston on a two-game streak. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery, averaging 33.3 points this season), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery), and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise), while Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 136-132 road win over Houston on April 10, 2026.
